name: domus
description: DOMUS - Plataforma digital para gestao e acompanhamento da rotina de corretores de imoveis

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix mobile install
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix mobile run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix backend run format && npm --prefix mobile run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix backend run format:check && npm --prefix mobile run format:check
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix mobile run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:mobile
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
